2124222260059799563.en_summary: Great summary of the extraordinary progress that was made in AI over the past 2 years. If we only looked at the start and end of $NVDA as a representative of the value of a key input into AI economy, it might look as though everything had been anticipated. But $NVDA went from $132 on June 14, 2024 to a recent high of ~$239 on Oct 6, 2026. Not everything was priced in. Meanwhile in private markets, OpenAI went 15x higher, and Anthropic 85x higher.
2124222260059799563.zh_summary: 過去 2 年 AI 非凡進展的精彩總結。如果我們只看 $NVDA 作為 AI 經濟關鍵投入價值的代表的開始和結束，看起來好像一切都已被預期。但 $NVDA 從 2024 年 6 月 14 日的 132 美元到 2026 年 10 月 6 日的近期高點約 239 美元。並非一切都已定價。同時在私人市場，OpenAI 上漲 15 倍，Anthropic 上漲 85 倍。
